rationale: The response adopts a formal, militaristic tone and applies it to the absurd situation, but it breaks register by suggesting non-military remedies like HOA escalation or moving the sprinkler head with a shovel.
quote: I reserve the right to exercise all lawful remedies, including but not limited to: - Documentation and escalation to homeowners’ association authorities - Installation of physical barriers - Preemptive relocation of your sprinkler head (with extreme prejudice and a shovel)
